item.title: U.S. Senate recognizes Indiana’s championship football season
item.description: The U.S. Senate unanimously passed a resolution congratulating the Indiana University football team for its undefeated, championship-winning season, recognizing the program's turnaround under Coach Cignetti, quarterback Fernando Mendoza's MVP play, and defensive lineman Mikail Kamara's performance.

item.title: Quadruple shooting on Indy’s southeast side leaves 2 dead, 2 injured
item.description: Two people were killed and a third person's condition is unknown after a triple shooting on Indy's southeast side Sunday morning.
